description: This file declares data structures and functions related to the 'resolve undo' feature in a version control system, likely Git. It includes function prototypes for recording, reading, writing, and clearing resolve undo information, as well as for unmerging index entries.

methods.name: record_resolve_undo
methods.description: Records undo information for a cache entry.

methods.name: resolve_undo_write
methods.description: Serializes and writes resolve undo information to a buffer.

methods.name: resolve_undo_read
methods.description: Reads and deserializes resolve undo information from a buffer.

methods.name: resolve_undo_clear_index
methods.description: Clears resolve undo data from the index.

methods.name: unmerge_index_entry
methods.description: Unmerges a specific index entry, storing undo info.

methods.name: unmerge_index
methods.description: Unmerges multiple index entries based on a pathspec.
